registration.phase: round3 paired G3 after tools coverage gate; conditional HANG/sweep expansion
registration.mode: G3 mode A physics-only, one independent run per arm/layout
registration.conditional_gate: fallback <25% across both pilot layouts per cell; all requests/speculative goals/native rejects count; no change of planner after pilots; rerun all ten paired layouts excluding pilot outcomes from score comparison
registration.counterbalance: even layout index A then B; odd B then A; both arms of each pair on same host

hosts.resource_fallback: An unadmitted pair/job waiting >=15 minutes may move to the other authorized host before either arm starts. This decision depends only on admission availability, never outcomes. Both arms of a pair stay on that host; report host-specific timing and per-pair hosts.

score_rule.source: origin/main docs/EXPERIMENTS.md at 18d97e56; explicitly requested by lead for this registration despite date-based grandfather clause
score_rule.success_flips: report separately, not gain pair-win definition

registration.camera_if_tools_gains: Write a new prospective camera A/B spec using this current score rule, fresh dev layouts and the stack guard; do not dispatch model calls.
